headlines.article_text: Anthropic IPO live updates: ANT stock price and Nasdaq debut Skip Navigation Markets Business Investing Tech Politics & Policy Video Watchlist Investing Club PRO Livestream Menu watch now VIDEO 4:58 04:58 Anthropic tops $2 trillion market cap in Nasdaq debut: Here’s what experts have to say Rapid Recap Anthropic jumped 17% in its Nasdaq debut on Thursday in a seminal moment for artificial intelligence, after the company completed the biggest initial public offering on record, topping SpaceX' s historic debut in June. The stock closed at $97.17 per share. The Claude creator, trading under the ticker "ANT," opened at $111.50, after the company raised $81.3 billion in the IPO. Anthropic sold 980 million shares at $83 a piece on Wednesday, lifting the size and price of its offering. At Thursday's close, Anthropic had a fully diluted market cap of roughly $1.8 trillion. More than 846 million shares changed hands, surpassing the 522 million shares that were traded on SpaceX's opening day. The 5-year-old company captivated the corporate world with its Claude AI models and products, which have fueled its meteoric rise this year. Anthropic said in its prospectus that it generated $33.24 billion in revenue for the nine months ended Sept. 30, up a staggering 1,200% from the same period last year. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei co-founded the company in 2021 after he and a small group of researchers defected from OpenAI , now its chief rival. Anthropic has faced sharp criticism over its positions on safety, regulation and national security, including by President Donald Trump and other senior government officials.
